title: petpaperdollframe
summary: MSUI's already conditional Pet tab is no longer an empty generic page. PetPaperDollUiLaw seats the current 384x512 child page's pet-specific bottom quadrants, 318x224 model pane, 35px rotation controls, 319x11 purple XP bar and dwarf-notch overlay, paired 114x78 attribute plates, five primary and five combat rows, five resistance icons, hunter-only diet/training affordances, and 80x22 Close button. A dedicated appearance-keyed full-body creature render target supplies the model; pet name, level/family, loyalty, XP, training points, stats and resistances come from live descriptors plus CreatureQuery/CreatureFamily/ItemPetFood data. All fifteen stat/resistance rows now expose their exact rule-owned hit rectangles and reference-shaped primary, attack, power, damage, defense, armor, and bare pet-resistance tooltip content through shared tooltip arbitration. Pet loss while this page is selected closes the character window as the reference does. A separate dedicated circular pet portrait also resolves the older pet-unit-frame booth gap. Focused and complete interface clinical checks pass; live verification remains.

openItems.text: The pet page's stat and resistance hover tooltips are not yet reproduced.
openItems.resolution: All five primary-stat rows, five combat-stat rows and five resistance icons now own their exact authored hit rectangles and publish reference-shaped tooltip titles/breakdowns through shared GameTooltip arbitration. Pet resistance hovers deliberately omit the character page's quality subtext.

openItems.text: Attack and Defense currently use the level-derived base when MSUI has no separate streamed pet weapon-skill/defense-skill modifier surface. Tooltip presence and all other visible descriptor rows are implemented; this remains a data-source calculation gap rather than a window-layout gap.

Live-verify hunter pet and warlock minion paths at representative gameplay scales: conditional tab reflow, name/level/family/loyalty, full-body crop and rotation, XP bar, stat plates and resistance UVs, training-point arithmetic, diet tooltip, both Close controls, painterly rebake, and pet-dismissal closure.
